verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms LlamaParse's platform publishes a live, keyless OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec ('Llama Platform') at api.cloud.llamaindex.ai/api/openapi.json, with the documented parsing endpoint properly auth-gated behind it — concrete machine-readable API spec evidence beyond mere docs claims. Missing for 10: no first-party docs page explicitly linking/advertising this OpenAPI file to users, and no independent (non-probe) confirmation of its completeness/versioning.
